title: Euclidean form of the correlated Gaussian measure
statement: Let $-1<\rho<1$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. Under the identification of the plane with $\mathbb R^2$, this distribution is the multivariate Gaussian with mean $(0,0)$ and covariance matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\\rho&1\end{pmatrix}$.
